name: tristan-shadowdancer-redirect-refused-with-one-preparation-counter
notes: Tristan, Shadowdancer (he6kd7hocc): "Remove two preparation counters from Tristan: Change the target of an attack that targets Tristan to a phantasia ally you control." The cost needs two preparation counters (activateAbilityPrereqs["he6kd7hocc:0"] requires GetPrepCounterCount() >= 2). Negative case for the Redirect fix: with a single counter the opportunity window must not open for Redirect (with two counters the sibling fixtures show the window "myField-0@Activate-0@Redirect" opening after the attack target is chosen), so the attack resolves immediately: Tristan takes the Dungeon Guide's 1 damage, keeps his single counter, stays awake, and the Ominous Shadow is untouched. No explicit rejected click is possible because no window exists; the per-step dump confirms the decision queue is empty right after the target choice and Damage went 0 -> 1.

rulesClauses: Remove two preparation counters from Tristan: Change the target of an attack that targets Tristan to a phantasia ally you control. (not offered without two counters)
